PROGRESS NOTE — OPD CONSULTATION CLINIC
Patient: Deepak Joshi    Age: 46    Date: 06/08/2026    Time: 17:30 AM
C/O: Pt c/o fever with chills, productive cough and headache x 3 days
K/C/O: Type 2 DM x 6 yrs on Tab Metformin 500 mg BD. No drug allergies
Vitals: BP: 118/76 mmHg, HR: 85 bpm, Temp: 99.2 F, SpO2: 97% on RA
O/E: Chest: Bilateral coarse crepitations, air entry equal bilaterally
     CVS: S1 S2 heard regular, no murmur. P/A: Soft, non-tender
Impression (Dx): Community Acquired Pneumonia (CAP) with URI
Plan: 1. Inj Ceftriaxone 1 g IV BD after test dose
      2. Tab Azithromycin 500 mg OD x 5 days
      3. Tab Paracetamol 650 mg SOS for fever
      4. Nebulization with Salbutamol + Budesonide Q8H
      5. Send CBC, CRP, Blood Culture, CXR PA view stat
Review in evening round with lab reports.
Attending Physician: Dr. S. Mehta, MD

HOSPITAL DISCHARGE SUMMARY
Patient Name: Pooja Bose
Age / Sex: 28 Yrs / M
Date of Admission: 04/08/2026
Date of Discharge: 06/08/2026
Consultant Doctor: Dr. Ananya Roy
Department: Consultant Pediatrician
FINAL DIAGNOSIS (Dx): Acute Calculous Cholecystitis s/p Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy
CONDITION AT DISCHARGE: Hemodynamically stable, afebrile, surgical wound clean and dry
DISCHARGE MEDICATIONS & REGIMEN:
1. Tab Augmentin 625 mg | 1-0-1 | x 5 days | After food
2. Tab Pantoprazole 40 mg | 1-0-0 | x 7 days | Before breakfast
3. Tab Paracetamol 650 mg | 1-0-1 | SOS | For pain/fever
4. Syp Liv-52 | 2 tsp BID | x 15 days | With water
FOLLOW-UP & POST-OP ADVICE:
Review in OPD after 7 days for suture removal. Emergency visit if fever or severe pain.
Authorized Medical Officer: Dr. Ananya Roy
